scrape-formats.markdown.evidence: 70681ca resolves URLs against the page URL and <base>, drops data: images, separates sibling blocks, keeps strong/em in non-p blocks, renders pre/tables in li, keeps ordered numbering; 17b383f prunes menu lists; tests packages/extract-tf/test/markdown.test.ts. Still open: the table strategy keeps only the largest table (route.ts selectTable), Wikipedia keeps [Edit links] and a legend table (live-batch-1-m1-recheck-2026-09-30.md), includeTags/excludeTags and removeBase64Images are M2 features.

scrape-formats.links.evidence: 8e0c03c: CrawlPage.links on batch items and crawl pages, asset hrefs (images, css, js, fonts, media) skipped, <base> honoured through markdown/link resolution; tests packages/extract-tf/test/metadata.test.ts (collectLinks), packages/api/test/app.test.ts (crawl pages carry links when asked).

scrape-formats.metadata-response-status.evidence: 8e0c03c: metadata {sourceURL,url,statusCode,contentType} on the compact response and /fc page, browser lane records the real content type and redirect chain, any 2xx is served, non-2xx returns the error page as markdown with an http_error warning; tests packages/bench/test/pageOptions.test.ts, packages/api/test/app.test.ts.

scrape-formats.json.evidence: 1b20f13: required arrays/objects are not invented as present, leaf names match only under subject-shaped parents, url/title/pageType carry evidence, schema annotations and anyOf/oneOf nullables accepted, deep merge with model provenance, strict decoding only for qualifying schemas; tests packages/api/test/structured.test.ts. Still open: prompt-only extraction, arrays are not descended without a model, the page is sent to the model unchunked, no BYO LLM client module.
